title: Application of Metrowest Engineering, Inc. of Framingham, Masaschusetts requesting a variance from the requirements in D.P.U. 12769 in the installation of a casing for the crossing of a hgh pressure natural gas pipeline by a roadway located in the Town of Hopkinton, with the proposed Carriage Hill Road and Prestwick Drive Extension.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Tierney, Alexander (90-41-K).

Application of Metrowest Engineering Inc. of Framingham, Massachusetts, requesting a variance from the requirements in DPU 12769, in the installation of a casing for the crossing of a high pressure natural gas pipeline by a roadway located in the town of Hopkinton with the proposed Carriage Hill Road and Prestwick Drive Extension.
